title: Update on the Collateral Ratio Under Portfolio Margin and the Leverage & Margin Tiers of USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contracts
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region.   Fellow Binancians, Binance will update the   collateral ratio  and   Tiered Collateral Ratio for PM Pro  for the following assets under Portfolio Margin from  2025-10-28 06:00 (UTC) and 2025-10-31 06:00 (UTC).  The update will be completed within approximately  30 minutes .
